instructions:
Proxidize proxy management server. Use these tools when the user asks about managing mobile proxies, rotating IPs, checking proxy status, listing locations or carriers, managing IP whitelists, tagging proxies, or viewing data usage. Supports per-proxy and per-GB proxies.

Proxies are reached through the gateway host pg.proxi.es. Per-proxy responses include ready-to-use http_url and socks_url values. The proxy field is 'username:password' credentials: HTTP ports accept them directly (e.g. curl -x <http_url> https://httpbin.org/ip), while SOCKS ports ignore credentials and require source-IP whitelisting first (get_outbound_ip, then create_ip_whitelist).

Analytics tools (get_traffic_analytics, get_top_domains, get_connection_history) answer questions about what the proxies actually did: bandwidth over time, top destination domains, and a per-request connection log with errors.

If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, and you have confirmed that, offer to draft a feature request with request_feature. Ask first, describe only the missing capability generically, and never include anything sensitive or about the user.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.title: Get Subscription
tools.description: Get active Proxidize subscriptions. Returns plan type, status, dates, and your proxy username. Omit type to list every active plan.

type.description: Canonical subscription type to query. Omit for all plans.

tools.name: get_outbound_ip
tools.title: Get Outbound IP
tools.description: Get the public outbound IP address of the machine running this MCP server. Useful for source-IP whitelisting.

tools.name: request_feature
tools.title: Request Feature
tools.description:
Draft a GitHub feature request for something this server cannot do. Returns a pre-filled issue link for the USER to review and submit; nothing is posted automatically.

Use ONLY when (1) the user wants something none of the available tools can do, AND (2) you have checked the tool list and confirmed no existing tool covers it, AND (3) the user agrees to file a request. Ask first.

Describe ONLY the missing capability, generically, based on what was asked in the conversation. The issue is public. NEVER include anything sensitive or about the user: no names, emails, usernames, passwords, API tokens, proxy credentials, IP addresses, hostnames, ports, account or subscription IDs, proxy IDs, domains they visit, company names, or quotes from the conversation. Use placeholders like <proxy> or <location> if an example is needed.

title.description: Short summary of the missing feature, e.g. 'Filter connection history by status code'

missing_capability.description: What the server cannot do today. Generic; no user data.

use_case.description: Why someone would want it, in general terms. No personal or account details.

suggested_behavior.description: Optional: how the tool/parameters could work. No real values.

related_tools.description: Optional: names of existing tools that are close but insufficient.

tools.name: list_proxies
tools.title: List Proxies
tools.description: List all per-proxy mobile proxies with their IPs, ports, speeds, and usage

tools.name: get_proxy
tools.title: Get Proxy
tools.description: Get details of a single proxy by session ID

session_id.description: Session ID (from list_proxies or proxy string after '-s-')

tools.name: rotate_proxy
tools.title: Rotate Proxy
tools.description: Rotate a proxy's IP address and return the old and new IP. Optionally lock to a specific city or carrier.

session_id.description: Session ID of the proxy to rotate (from list_proxies or proxy string after '-s-')

carrier.description: Lock rotation to a carrier ID (e.g. '6614')

tools.name: rotate_proxy_url
tools.title: Rotate Proxy via URL
tools.description: Rotate a proxy by its rotation token (the token at the end of the rotation URL)

rotation_token.description: Rotation token from the proxy's public_key field

tools.name: set_rotation_interval
tools.title: Set Rotation Interval
tools.description: Set automatic IP rotation interval for a proxy. Use -1 to disable.

session_id.description: Session ID of the proxy (from list_proxies or proxy string after '-s-')

public_key.description: Public key token from the proxy's rotate URL

interval.description: Interval in seconds (min 60, max 604800). Use -1 to disable.

tools.name: get_traffic_analytics
tools.title: Get Traffic Analytics
tools.description: Bandwidth and request analytics over time for your proxies: bytes transferred per time bucket (per proxy session or access point) plus total and failed request counts. Defaults to the last 24 hours across all active plans.

hours.description: Lookback window in hours ending now (default 24, max 2160 = 90 days)

from.description: Window start as ISO 8601 timestamp; overrides hours

to.description: Window end as ISO 8601 timestamp (default now)

plan.description: Restrict to one plan. Omit to cover every active plan.

tools.name: get_top_domains
tools.title: Get Top Domains
tools.description: Top domains your proxies connected to, ranked by data volume and by request count. Defaults to the last 24 hours across all active plans.

hours.description: Lookback window in hours ending now (default 24, max 2160 = 90 days)

from.description: Window start as ISO 8601 timestamp; overrides hours

to.description: Window end as ISO 8601 timestamp (default now)

plan.description: Restrict to one plan. Omit to cover every active plan.

tools.name: get_connection_history
tools.title: Get Connection History
tools.description: Per-request connection log for your proxies: URL, method, status, duration, bytes up/down, source IP, upstream carrier/geo, session, and errors. Newest first. Defaults to the last 24 hours across all active plans. When plan is omitted, results are merged across plans and offset applies within each plan. A 'blocked domain' errorType means the destination is restricted by Proxidize's Acceptable Use Policy (not an auth/token problem) — some categories need KYB verification to unlock, see the returned hint field or https://proxidize.com/kyc/.

hours.description: Lookback window in hours ending now (default 24, max 2160 = 90 days)

from.description: Window start as ISO 8601 timestamp; overrides hours

to.description: Window end as ISO 8601 timestamp (default now)

plan.description: Restrict to one plan. Omit to cover every active plan.

url_contains.description: Only requests whose URL contains this substring
